name: Kierstin Jonsdotter — a daughter Anna christened 1777 at Rättvik
researcher_question: Was the Anna christened 12 January 1777 at Rättvik, daughter of Anders Ersson and Kierstin Jöransdotter, a daughter of Kierstin Jonsdotter and Anders Hansson?
notes: Record-hint fixture (filtered-list-samples-2.csv row 27, hint-samples.csv row 853, flag adds_daughter, confidence 3). Resolved 2026-09-24 (issue #2320) as a false match: the 1777 Anna belongs to the distinct Rättvik couple Anders Ersson and Kierstin Jöransdotter (siblings 1779, 1784, 1787 in the same index). Index-only evidence; the register images were not examined.
